**Back up first.** Before you install this version, make a backup in Settings › Backup & data.

**Links open inside Forkcast**
- Ko-fi, GitHub, the setup guides and other web links now open in a browser tab on top of Forkcast, in the app's light or dark colors. Close it to come straight back to where you were.
- It's still your phone's own browser, so sign-ins and saved payment methods work as usual, and Forkcast can't see the page.
- Links that an installed app handles, such as GitHub's, open in that app.
